gloss: to be concerned about; to worry about; to fear

definitions.gloss: to be concerned about; to worry about; to fear
definitions.explanation: To feel anxiety or apprehension about something that may happen, especially regarding serious or public matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{懸念|けねん}する⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are voices expressing concern about safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{懸念|けねん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Experts are concerned about the impact on the economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}{汚染|おせん}→環境汚染：21102_kankyouosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{懸念|けねん}して⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Residents started a protest movement out of concern about environmental pollution from the factory construction.

notes:
A formal word for worry or concern, used primarily in written language, news reports, and official statements. It implies concern about something serious or consequential, not everyday personal worries. The noun form ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧ is very common on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to express concern
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor concerns
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧: cause for concern
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}{事項|じこう}→懸念事項：17071_kenenjikou⟧: matter of concern
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: concerns spread

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}する→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧: to worry — the everyday, general-purpose word for worrying, used for both personal and public matters
- ⟦{憂慮|ゆうりょ}する→憂慮する：22524_yuuryosuru⟧: to be gravely concerned — even more formal and literary than {懸念|けねん}する, often used in diplomatic or academic contexts
- ⟦{危惧|きぐ}→危惧：11862_kigu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fear; to be apprehensive — emphasizes fear that something bad will happen, often used about endangered species or serious risks
